Anna (Design): Heads-up — noticed the action strip in the dense dashboard is causing the table to reflow on small phones. Buttons wrap onto two rows and push the table header down, looks jumpy :eyes:
Maya (Product): Can you repro and share a screenshot?
Anna (Design): Yep, repro on iPhone 8 / SE widths. Happens when width < 420px and there are 4+ primary actions in the strip. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/mock/action-strip-wrap.png
Javier (Mobile): Confirmed in WKWebView and Safari. The safe-area inset + wrap causes the strip to overlap the sticky header during fast scrolls.
Kev (Eng): Is the strip using position: sticky? We could reserve space with a fixed height, but that's brittle. Prefer collapsing overflow into a "More" menu at tight widths.
Maya (Product): +1 to a More fallback. Also consider icons-only at the next breakpoint to avoid hiding actions completely.
Anna (Design): Icons-only improves density but hurts discoverability. Proposal: keep primary action as full button, collapse secondary actions into an overflow menu. Also ensure minimum hit targets (44px).
Javier (Mobile): Another option is a horizontally scrollable action strip with momentum scrolling. Quick CSS to try: `.action-strip { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }` That avoids wrapping but keeps actions reachable.
Kev (Eng): If we go scrollable, we must add proper a11y: `aria-label="Action strip"`, keyboard tabbable items, and a visible focus ring. Also document the fallback to "More" when JS detects overflow.
Anna (Design): Small copy tweak request: use "More actions" for the overflow button label. Also ensure menu item labels are concise and not duplicated. Accessibility nits: show focus outline, 44x44 hitbox, and provide `aria-haspopup`/`aria-expanded` on the overflow trigger.
Maya (Product): Next steps: Anna to mock 3 variants (icons-only, scrollable strip, collapse-to-menu). Engineering to prototype scrollable strip with More fallback. Javier to test on real devices for WKWebView/android quirks.
Javier (Mobile): I'll prototype today. Note: Android momentum scroll sometimes causes the strip to briefly bounce; may need `touch-action: pan-x` or `overscroll-behavior: contain` tweaks.
Kev (Eng): I'll add responsive rules to the breakpoints doc: <=420px -> collapse to More; 421-480px -> icons-only (with tooltip); >=481px -> full labels. We can iterate after a live test.
Anna (Design): Thanks — ping me when the prototype is up so I can validate spacing and icon labels. Also I'll add screenshots showing the overlap bug into the ticket. :bug:
Maya (Product): Adding this as a follow-up for sprint planning and tagging customer-impact. :spiral_calendar:
Design-Bot: Automated note: created ticket RDC-1129: "Dense dashboard action strip - mobile overflow behavior" and linked this thread.
Kev (Eng): I'll link my quick CSS prototype in the ticket once pushed. :thumbsup:
